strategy_roster.name: Long Term Profitable Swing
strategy_roster.notes: The documented EMA(16)/EMA(30) crossover and RSI(9)>50 entry are direct, with the inverse conditions as the long exit. ATR(21) 8x/11x stops and target are dynamic and cannot be encoded as fixed percentage fields.

strategy_roster.name: Q2MA Cross
strategy_roster.notes: SMA(8) of close versus open follows the documented crossover direction exactly, including the stated bullish branch. The source's tick offsets (1000/2000), H4 timeframe, and opposite-side permissions are not percentage/DSL fields.

strategy_roster.name: Lavika100 Strategy (StockSharp)
strategy_roster.notes: EMA(9)/EMA(21) and ROC(5) are explicit fallbacks for the undocumented H1/H4 RAVI filter and signal reversal. Multi-timeframe RAVI, money modes, trailing points, and position permissions are not available.

strategy_roster.name: Exp Color TSI Oscillator
strategy_roster.notes: MACD(12,26,9) line/signal crossover is a practical proxy for the documented double-smoothed TSI swing reversal. Color TSI phases, trigger shift, SignalBar, and 1000/2000-point protection are not directly representable.

strategy_roster.name: MFS 3 Bars Pattern
strategy_roster.entry_long: close > open and roc(close,3) > 0 and sma(close,20) > sma(close,50) and close > sma(close,20)
strategy_roster.notes: A three-bar bullish recovery with SMA(20)>SMA(50) approximates the ignite, pullback, and confirmation sequence. The exact candle bodies, short/medium/long downtrend condition, ignite-low stop, and risk-reward target are not expressible.

strategy_roster.name: BB RSI Trailing Stop
strategy_roster.notes: A lower Bollinger(25,2) pierce with an RSI(14) recross above 33 represents the long confirmation; the middle band and overbought RSI provide exits. Point-based initial stop and conditional trailing management remain null.

strategy_roster.name: TFM
strategy_roster.notes: A two-bar prior high break approximates the multiplied-timeframe level and its opposite low exit. The 1-minute multiplier, optional short flag, reversal mode, and session timing are not available.

strategy_roster.name: MCOTs Intuition
strategy_roster.notes: RSI momentum above one standard deviation while its ROC turns negative approximates strong-but-exhausting momentum. The exact previous-momentum comparison, tick stop/target, and short exhaustion branch are unsupported.

strategy_roster.name: Zs1 Forex Instruments
strategy_roster.notes: The strategy is a hedged martingale grid driven by Level1 zones rather than a deterministic long indicator, so the impossible guard avoids inventing a signal. Basket state, pip zones, and volume constraints are outside the DSL.

strategy_roster.name: Williams VIX Fix
strategy_roster.notes: ATR(20) above its 50-bar mean and a lower Bollinger(20,2) break approximate the Williams VIX Fix fear spike; the inverse ATR/upper-band condition exits. The synthetic VIX inversion and percentile calculations are not directly available.
